title: Understanding the Task
text: You need to fill in the blanks to add two columns to the DataFrame: $$'number_{of,W'}$$ and $$'mean_{Q'}$$. Focus on how to count specific patterns in strings and calculate averages.

title: Identifying Patterns
text: For $$'number_{of,W'}$$, you need to count words with an uppercase 'W' surrounded by uppercase letters. Think about how you can identify these patterns without using the 're' library.

title: Calculating Averages
text: For $$'mean_{Q'}$$, you need to calculate the average of two critic ratings. Consider how you can achieve this using basic arithmetic operations.

title: Filling Blank (iii)
text: To count the number of patterns found, use a method that returns the length of a list or sequence.
